invalid_payload.label: Invalid validation payload
invalid_payload.description: The request body did not include a valid config object.

missing_pipeline.label: Missing pipeline block
missing_pipeline.description: The configuration must contain a pipeline object.

invalid_section_type.label: Invalid plugin section format
invalid_section_type.description: A plugin section is not encoded as an array.

invalid_plugin_item.label: Invalid plugin entry
invalid_plugin_item.description: A plugin entry is not an object.

missing_plugin_name.label: Missing plugin name
missing_plugin_name.description: A plugin entry must include a non-empty name.

unknown_plugin.label: Unknown plugin
unknown_plugin.description: The selected plugin name is not valid for that section.

missing_required_field.label: Missing required field
missing_required_field.description: A mandatory plugin field has not been provided.

unknown_field.label: Unknown field
unknown_field.description: The configuration contains a field that is not defined for the plugin.

ui_message.label: UI validation message
ui_message.description: The UI generated a local validation or status message.

pydantic_validation_error.label: Request validation error
pydantic_validation_error.description: The submitted request did not match the API contract.

unknown_issue.label: Validation issue
unknown_issue.description: A validation issue was reported without a known code mapping.
